text: Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment in OC_comments (JSON list of non-OP comments, parsed as a list) directly quotes wording from the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim reuse, typically in quotation marks or block-quote markup), checked against the supplied title/argument as context; the comment need not agree, disagree or refute. Paraphrase, mere topic mention, quotes of third-party sources or of other commenters do not count. Ignore OP view-change/delta announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting the outcome in the argument (neither quote source nor evidence; generic delta/platform rule discussion remains eligible); use current text, no reconstruction of initial snapshots. Output 0 if the list is valid but empty or no comment quotes OP text; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if title and argument are both missing so a negative can't be established (a positive match to available OP text is still 1).
